prompts.name: companion_jellyfish
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Transparent 2D mobile doodle game sprite. Simple flat colors, very thick smooth BLACK outlines, minimal detail, no textured realism, no gradient lighting, no glow or drop shadows. Replace the sun robot with a cute JELLYFISH FAIRY floating companion. One large rounded pink-lavender jellyfish bell HEAD, softly domed top and three short scallops along the bottom edge integrated into the head. Two friendly big white eyes and black pupils glancing slightly right, small smiling mouth, one simple pale lilac oval highlight. NO sun rays, ring, crown, long tentacles, body or legs. Pair of three-lobed rounded FEATHER wings lavender with pale pink tips. Maintain three separate sprites: big head centered in upper 65% of canvas, detached left and right wing below in lower 25%, same layout as reference. True transparent background, fully opaque interior. No labels, text or decorative background. Use reference only for style, friendly eyes and separated sprite sheet layout. Portrait 1500x1700 composition.
